svg.text: Projection pushes blood out into the world. Absorption pulls it back.
docs/core_loop · proposal, nothing approved · design illustration, not in-game art
A creature, a wet stain, a tank you fed a
minute ago: anything that holds blood gives it
WHO ANSWERS THE BUTTON · THE FIRST CLAIM WINS
Cardinal Rites, Saints, Wills and the blocks
that take blood keep everything they do today.
The selected manipulation, when it claims this
target. Lignum Mortis at a log. Pyretic Forge at
loose ore. A combat manipulation at open air.
Otherwise the blood simply lands or lifts: a
stain on the wall, a draw from a creature.
Two buttons. What they do depends on what they touch and what is selected.
